pack: CIS SQL Server core (toward full automatable coverage)

checks.title: Server uses Windows Authentication mode only
checks.remediation: Set the server to Windows Authentication mode (unless SQL logins are required).

checks.title: 'external scripts enabled' is disabled
checks.query: SELECT CAST(value_in_use AS INT) v FROM sys.configurations WHERE name='external scripts enabled'
checks.remediation: EXEC sp_configure 'external scripts enabled',0; RECONFIGURE; (unless ML Services is used).

checks.title: serveradmin role membership limited
checks.query: SELECT p.name FROM sys.server_role_members m JOIN sys.server_principals p ON p.principal_id=m.member_principal_id JOIN sys.server_principals r ON r.principal_id=m.role_principal_id WHERE r.name='serveradmin' AND p.name NOT LIKE '##%'
checks.remediation: ALTER SERVER ROLE serveradmin DROP MEMBER [<login>];

checks.query: SELECT p.name FROM sys.server_role_members m JOIN sys.server_principals p ON p.principal_id=m.member_principal_id JOIN sys.server_principals r ON r.principal_id=m.role_principal_id WHERE r.name='setupadmin' AND p.name NOT LIKE '##%'
checks.remediation: ALTER SERVER ROLE setupadmin DROP MEMBER [<login>];

checks.title: bulkadmin role membership limited

checks.remediation: ALTER SERVER ROLE bulkadmin DROP MEMBER [<login>]; — bulkadmin can read server files via BULK INSERT.

checks.title: A server audit specification is enabled
checks.query: SELECT name FROM sys.server_audit_specifications WHERE is_state_enabled=1
checks.remediation: Create + enable a Server Audit Specification (login/permission-change groups) per CIS §5.

checks.title: User databases have Transparent Data Encryption
checks.query: SELECT d.name FROM sys.databases d WHERE d.database_id>4 AND d.state=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.dm_database_encryption_keys k WHERE k.database_id=d.database_id AND k.encryption_state=3)
checks.remediation: Enable TDE on user databases holding sensitive data.

checks.title: No user symmetric keys in the master database
checks.query: SELECT name FROM master.sys.symmetric_keys WHERE name NOT LIKE '##%'
checks.remediation: Move user symmetric keys out of master into the relevant application database.

checks.title: No user asymmetric keys in the master database
checks.query: SELECT name FROM master.sys.asymmetric_keys WHERE name NOT LIKE '##%'
checks.remediation: Move user asymmetric keys out of master into the relevant application database.
